title: A body in a static field that is not sharp: mixture over sectors, fall, clock rate and the relation (4.24)

open_issues: The cross part of the first-order velocity in the subclass S_a, (9.18), is an order estimate O(λ^(1/2)) by stationary phase; a bound with explicit constants of the kind of (4.10) was not derived, also for the part with the plain gradient of the records.

For (9.8) and (9.14) the order δp → 0 at fixed λ, then λ → ∞, is not determined when the gradients of the level do not all vanish on S (⟨b_k²⟩_w > 0), because the bound (9.22) contains X_g; the combined limit is shown under the sufficient condition X_g/λ → 0, and its necessity is not shown; when all gradients of the level vanish on S the spread and the covariance vanish identically and the limit is zero in either order.
The mean over the sectors of the sector variances of the position label in (9.2), at second order in the gradients, is outside the scope; only the term over the sectors is determined.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of (9.6), (9.8), (9.14), (9.20), (9.22), (9.23), (9.24) and of the new (9.25), (9.26), (9.27), with the plain gradient -κ⟨X⟩ of the records counted as an inverse λ

Sharp field: all variances and covariances over the sectors vanish, the results reduce to the quoted inputs, (9.19), (9.24) reduce to the sector values of (9.23), the mixed moment and the rest of (9.26) vanish, and (9.27) gives the sector split of (9.23); for ⟨X⟩ = 0 the parts of the records vanish
Two sectors with equal weights, control (9.11): direct evaluation of the mean, of the variance (9.8) and of the condition (9.15)
